_comment: Seed accounts for the SonicSentinel AI demonstration build. These are DELIBERATELY published credentials: SRS §1.10 item 11 requires the submitted application to ship with evaluator and administrator credentials plus testing instructions. This file is not a secret and must never be reused for anything real. Change it (or set SST_SEED_CREDENTIALS to another file) before putting this anywhere but a demonstration.

users.purpose: Full access: user management, audit trail, retention, live config edits, everything a reviewer or operator can do.
The account handed to the evaluator. Admin rights so that every screen, queue and report can be inspected without a role switch mid-demonstration.
Manual-review queue: decide, comment, override. Can search all events and export. Cannot acknowledge alerts or change configuration.
Alert handling: acknowledge, dismiss, escalate, and read the alert history. Cannot register models or edit rules.
Model versions and live configuration: register and activate a trained model, edit thresholds and alert rules, view config history. Cannot acknowledge alerts or decide reviews.
Upload audio and run a microphone session, and see the results of their own events only. Proves the role boundary: every reviewer/operator/admin endpoint answers 403, not a hidden link.
